{"consolidated_memory":"STALE STATE IN ui/state/cacheSlice.ts - THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

All three incidents involved stale state in the cache slice (web ui side), reproduced by editing a record then navigating back to the list, signaled by an old value remaining in the store snapshot. All were fixed in PR submissions on dedicated fix branches. Context: ongoing work in the same corner of ui/state/cacheSlice.ts related to stale state management.

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-07]
- Trigger: first request after cold start only
- Root cause: cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #3677 on branch fix/stale-state-2
- Outcome: flaky test reduced from 29 failures per 100 runs to zero

INCIDENT 2 [2026-03-27]
- Trigger: payloads above roughly 2 megabytes only
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #3908 on branch fix/stale-state-3
- Outcome: job execution time reduced from 3 hours to 61 minutes

INCIDENT 3 [2026-05-08]
- Trigger: staging read replica only
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #4857 on branch fix/stale-state-4
- Outcome: reclaimed 67 GB of blob storage"}
